ayahs.ar: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡزَلَ عَلٰي عَبۡدِهِ الۡكِتٰبَ وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡ لَّهٗ عِوَجًاؕࣝ‏
ayahs.tl: Alhamdu lillaahil lazeee anzala 'alaa 'abdihil kitaaba wa lam yaj'al lahoo 'iwajaa
ayahs.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.

ayahs.ar: قَيِّمًا لِّيُنۡذِرَ بَاۡسًا شَدِيۡدًا مِّنۡ لَّدُنۡهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ اَجۡرًا حَسَنًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaiyimal liyunzira baasan shadeedam mil ladunhu wa yubashshiral mu'mineenal lazeena ya'maloonas saalihaati anna lahum ajran hasanaa
ayahs.en: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward

ayahs.ar: مَّاكِثِيۡنَ فِيۡهِ اَبَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Maakiseena feehi abadaa
ayahs.en: In which they will remain forever

ayahs.ar: وَّيُنۡذِرَ الَّذِيۡنَ قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ وَلَدًاࣗ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yunziral lazeena qaalut takhazal laahu waladaa
ayahs.en: And to warn those who say, "Allah has taken a son."

ayahs.ar: مَا لَهُمۡ بِهٖ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ وَّلَا لِاٰبَآئِهِمۡؕ كَبُرَتۡ كَلِمَةً تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡؕ اِنۡ يَّقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِلَّا كَذِبًا
ayahs.tl: Maa lahum bihee min 'ilminw wa laa li aabaaa'ihim; kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwaahihim; iny yaqooloona illaa kazibaa
ayahs.en: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.

ayahs.ar: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفۡسَكَ عَلٰ٘ي اٰثَارِهِمۡ اِنۡ لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡا بِهٰذَا الۡحَدِيۡثِ اَسَفًا
ayahs.tl: Fala'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka 'alaaa aasaarihim illam yu;minoo bihaazal hadeesi asafaa
ayahs.en: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا مَا عَلَي الۡاَرۡضِ زِيۡنَةً لَّهَا لِنَبۡلُوَهُمۡ اَيُّهُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ عَمَلًا
ayahs.tl: Innaa ja'alnaa ma 'alal ardi zeenatal lahaa linabluwahum ayyuhum ahsanu 'amalaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّا لَجٰعِلُوۡنَ مَا عَلَيۡهَا صَعِيۡدًا جُرُزًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa innaa lajaa 'iloona maa 'alaihaa sa'aeedan juruzaa
ayahs.en: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ حَسِبۡتَ اَنَّ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡكَهۡفِ وَالرَّقِيۡمِ كَانُوۡا مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا عَجَبًا
ayahs.tl: Am hasibta anna Ashaabal Kahfi war Raqeemi kaanoo min Aayaatinaa 'ajabaa
ayahs.en: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ اَوَي الۡفِتۡيَةُ اِلَي الۡكَهۡفِ فَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا٘ اٰتِنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡكَ رَحۡمَةً وَّهَيِّئۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَمۡرِنَا رَشَدًا
ayahs.tl: Iz awal fityatu ilal Kahfi faqaaloo Rabbanaaa aatinaa mil ladunka rahmatanw wa haiyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
ayahs.en: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."

ayahs.ar: فَضَرَبۡنَا عَلٰ٘ي اٰذَانِهِمۡ فِي الۡكَهۡفِ سِنِيۡنَ عَدَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fadarabnaa 'alaaa aazaanihim fil Kahfi seneena 'adadaa
ayahs.en: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنٰهُمۡ لِنَعۡلَمَ اَيُّ الۡحِزۡبَيۡنِ اَحۡصٰي لِمَا لَبِثُوۡ٘ا اَمَدًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa ba'asnaahum lina'lama ayyul hizbaini ahsaa limaa labisooo amadaa
ayahs.en: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.

ayahs.ar: نَحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ نَبَاَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّؕ اِنَّهُمۡ فِتۡيَةٌ اٰمَنُوۡا بِرَبِّهِمۡ وَزِدۡنٰهُمۡ هُدًيࣗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Nahnu naqussu 'alaika naba ahum bilhaqq; innahum fityatun aamanoo bi Rabbihim wa zidnaahum hudaa
ayahs.en: It is We who relate to you, [O Muhammad], their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.

ayahs.ar: وَّرَبَطۡنَا عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ اِذۡ قَامُوۡا فَقَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ لَنۡ نَّدۡعُوَا۠ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اِلٰهًا لَّقَدۡ قُلۡنَا٘ اِذًا شَطَطًا
ayahs.tl: Wa rabatnaa 'alaa quloo bihim iz qaamoo faqaaloo Rabbunaa Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi lan nad'uwa min dooniheee ilaahal laqad qulnaaa izan shatataa
ayahs.en: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.

ayahs.ar: هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمُنَا اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اٰلِهَةًؕ لَوۡلَا يَاۡتُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍۭ بَيِّنٍؕ فَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Haaa'ulaaa'i qawmunat takhazoo min dooniheee aalihatal law laa yaatoona 'alaihim bisultaanim baiyin; faman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alal laahi kazibaa
ayahs.en: These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear authority? And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie?"

ayahs.ar: وَاِذِ اعۡتَزَلۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ فَاۡوٗ٘ا اِلَي الۡكَهۡفِ يَنۡشُرۡ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّحۡمَتِهٖ وَيُهَيِّئۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَمۡرِكُمۡ مِّرۡفَقًا
ayahs.tl: Wa izi'tazal tumoohum wa maa ya'budoona illal laaha faawooo ilal kahfi yanshur lakum Rabbukum mir rahmatihee wa yuhaiyi' lakum min amrikum mirfaqa
ayahs.en: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah, retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَي الشَّمۡسَ اِذَا طَلَعَتۡ تَّزٰوَرُ عَنۡ كَهۡفِهِمۡ ذَاتَ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَاِذَا غَرَبَتۡ تَّقۡرِضُهُمۡ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ فَجۡوَةٍ مِّنۡهُؕ ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِؕ مَنۡ يَّهۡدِ اللّٰهُ فَهُوَ الۡمُهۡتَدِۚ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلۡ فَلَنۡ تَجِدَ لَهٗ وَلِيًّا مُّرۡشِدًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa tarash shamsa izaa tala'at tazaawaru 'an kahfihim zaatal yameeni wa izaa gharabat taqriduhum zaatash shimaali wa hum fee fajwatim minh; zaalika min Aayaatillaah; mai yahdil laahu fahuwal muhtad, wa mai yudlil falan tajida lahoo waliyyam murshidaa
ayahs.en: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allah. He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.

ayahs.ar: وَتَحۡسَبُهُمۡ اَيۡقَاظًا وَّهُمۡ رُقُوۡدٌࣗۖ وَّنُقَلِّبُهُمۡ ذَاتَ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَذَاتَ الشِّمَالِࣗۖ وَكَلۡبُهُمۡ بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيۡهِ بِالۡوَصِيۡدِؕ لَوِ اطَّلَعۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَوَلَّيۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ فِرَارًا وَّلَمُلِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ رُعۡبًا
ayahs.tl: Wa tahsabuhum ayqaazanw wa hum ruqood; wa nuqallibuhum zaatal yameeni wa zaatash shimaali wa kalbuhum baasitun ziraa'ayhi bilwaseed; lawit tala'ta 'alaihim la wallaita minhum firaaranw wa lamuli'ta minhum rubaa
ayahs.en: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ بَعَثۡنٰهُمۡ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوۡا بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡؕ قَالُوۡا لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا اَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٍؕ قَالُوۡا رَبُّكُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثۡتُمۡؕ فَابۡعَثُوۡ٘ا اَحَدَكُمۡ بِوَرِقِكُمۡ هٰذِهٖ٘ اِلَي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ فَلۡيَنۡظُرۡ اَيُّهَا٘ اَزۡكٰي طَعَامًا فَلۡيَاۡتِكُمۡ بِرِزۡقٍ مِّنۡهُ وَلۡيَتَۙلَطَّفۡ وَلَا يُشۡعِرَنَّ بِكُمۡ اَحَدًا
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika ba'asnaahum liyatasaaa'aloo bainahum; qaala qaaa'ilum minhum kam labistum qaaloo labisnaa yawman aw ba'da yawm; qaaloo Rabbukum a'almu bimaa labistum fab'asooo ahadakum biwariqikum haazihee ilal madeenati falyanzur ayyuhaaa azkaa ta'aaman falyaatikum birizqim minhu walyatalattaf wa laa yush'iranna bikum ahadaa
ayahs.en: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّهُمۡ اِنۡ يَّظۡهَرُوۡا عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَرۡجُمُوۡكُمۡ اَوۡ يُعِيۡدُوۡكُمۡ فِيۡ مِلَّتِهِمۡ وَلَنۡ تُفۡلِحُوۡ٘ا اِذًا اَبَدًا
ayahs.tl: Innahum iny yazharoo 'alaikum yarjumookum aw yu'eedookum fee millatihim wa lan tuflihooo izan abadaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever."

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَعۡثَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ لِيَعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّاَنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهَاࣗۚ اِذۡ يَتَنَازَعُوۡنَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ اَمۡرَهُمۡ فَقَالُوا ابۡنُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بُنۡيَانًاؕ رَبُّهُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ بِهِمۡؕ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ غَلَبُوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اَمۡرِهِمۡ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّسۡجِدًا
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika a'sarnaa 'alaihim liya'lamooo anna wa'dal laahi haqqunw wa annas Saa'ata laa raiba feehaa iz yatanaaza'oona bainahum amrahum faqaalub noo 'alaihim bunyaanaa; Rabbuhum a'lamu bihim; qaalal lazeena ghalaboo 'alaaa amrihim lanat takhizanna 'alaihim masjidaa
ayahs.en: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allah is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt. [That was] when they disputed among themselves about their affair and [then] said, "Construct over them a structure. Their Lord is most knowing about them." Said those who prevailed in the matter, "We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid."

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ ثَلٰثَةٌ رَّابِعُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡۚ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ خَمۡسَةٌ سَادِسُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡ رَجۡمًاۭ بِالۡغَيۡبِۚ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ سَبۡعَةٌ وَّثَامِنُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡؕ قُلۡ رَّبِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِمۡ مَّا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلٌ ࣢ࣞ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيۡهِمۡ اِلَّا مِرَآءً ظَاهِرًاࣕ وَّلَا تَسۡتَفۡتِ فِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡهُمۡ اَحَدًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Sa yaqooloona salaasatur raabi'uhum kalbuhum wa yaqooloona khamsatun saadisuhum kalbuhum rajmam bilghaib; wa yaqooloona sab'atunw wa saaminuhum kalbuhum; qur Rabbeee a'lamu bi'iddatihim maa ya'lamuhum illaa qaleel; falaa tumaari feehim illaa miraaa'an zaahiranw wa laa tastafti feehim minhum ahadaa
ayahs.en: They will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone."

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَقُوۡلَنَّ لِشَايۡءٍ اِنِّيۡ فَاعِلٌ ذٰلِكَ غَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa taqoolanna lishai'in innee faa'ilun zaalika ghadaa
ayahs.en: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow,"

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُؗ وَاذۡكُرۡ رَّبَّكَ اِذَا نَسِيۡتَ وَقُلۡ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّهۡدِيَنِ رَبِّيۡ لِاَقۡرَبَ مِنۡ هٰذَا رَشَدًا
ayahs.tl: Illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; wazkur Rabbaka izaa naseeta wa qul 'asaaa any yahdiyani Rabbee li aqraba min haazaa rashadaa
ayahs.en: Except [when adding], "If Allah wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."

ayahs.ar: وَلَبِثُوۡا فِيۡ كَهۡفِهِمۡ ثَلٰثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِيۡنَ وَازۡدَادُوۡا تِسۡعًا
ayahs.tl: Wa labisoo fee kahfihim salaasa mi'atin sineena wazdaadoo tis'aa
ayahs.en: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.

ayahs.ar: قُلِ اللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوۡاۚ لَهٗ غَيۡبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ اَبۡصِرۡ بِهٖ وَاَسۡمِعۡؕ مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّؗ وَّلَا يُشۡرِكُ فِيۡ حُكۡمِهٖ٘ اَحَدًا
ayahs.tl: Qulil laahu a'lamu bimaa labisoo lahoo ghaibus samaawaati wal ardi absir bihee wa asmi'; maa lahum min doonihee minw waliyyinw wa laa yushriku fee hukmihee ahadaa
ayahs.en: Say, "Allah is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He shares not His legislation with anyone."

ayahs.ar: وَاتۡلُ مَا٘ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡكَ مِنۡ كِتَابِ رَبِّكَؕ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمٰتِهٖۚࣞ وَلَنۡ تَجِدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مُلۡتَحَدًا
ayahs.tl: Watlu maaa oohiya ilaika min Kitaabi Rabbika laa mubaddila li Kalimaatihee wa lan tajida min doonihee multahadaa
ayahs.en: And recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and never will you find in other than Him a refuge.

ayahs.ar: وَاصۡبِرۡ نَفۡسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ بِالۡغَدٰوةِ وَالۡعَشِيِّ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ وَجۡهَهٗ وَلَا تَعۡدُ عَيۡنٰكَ عَنۡهُمۡۚ تُرِيۡدُ زِيۡنَةَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مَنۡ اَغۡفَلۡنَا قَلۡبَهٗ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِنَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ وَكَانَ اَمۡرُهٗ فُرُطًا
ayahs.tl: Wasbir nafsaka ma'al lazeena yad'oona Rabbahum bilghadaati wal'ashiyyi yureedoona Wajhahoo wa laa ta'du 'aynaaka 'anhum tureedu zeenatal hayaatid dunyaa wa laa tuti' man aghfalnaa qalbahoo 'an zikrinaa wattaba'a hawaahu wa kaana amruhoo furutaa
ayahs.en: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His countenance. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair is ever [in] neglect.

ayahs.ar: وَقُلِ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡࣞ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ فَلۡيُؤۡمِنۡ وَّمَنۡ شَآءَ فَلۡيَكۡفُرۡۚ اِنَّا٘ اَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ نَارًا اَحَاطَ بِهِمۡ سُرَادِقُهَاؕ وَاِنۡ يَّسۡتَغِيۡثُوۡا يُغَاثُوۡا بِمَآءٍ كَالۡمُهۡلِ يَشۡوِي الۡوُجُوۡهَؕ بِئۡسَ الشَّرَابُؕ وَسَآءَتۡ مُرۡتَفَقًا
ayahs.tl: Wa qulil haqqu mir Rabbikum faman shaaa'a falyu minw wa man shaaa'a falyakfur; innaaa a'tadnaa lizzaalimeena Naaran ahaata bihim suraadiquhaa; wa iny yastagheesoo yaghaasoo bimaaa'in kalmuhli yashwil wujooh' bi'sash-sharaab; wa saaa'at murtafaqaa
ayahs.en: And say, "The truth is from your Lord, so whoever wills - let him believe; and whoever wills - let him disbelieve." Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اِنَّا لَا نُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ مَنۡ اَحۡسَنَ عَمَلًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati innaa laa nudee'u ajra man ahsana 'amalaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who did well in deeds.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهِمُ الۡاَنۡهٰرُ يُحَلَّوۡنَ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ اَسَاوِرَ مِنۡ ذَهَبٍ وَّيَلۡبَسُوۡنَ ثِيَابًا خُضۡرًا مِّنۡ سُنۡدُسٍ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ مُّتَّكِـِٕيۡنَ فِيۡهَا عَلَي الۡاَرَآئِكِؕ نِعۡمَ الثَّوَابُؕ وَحَسُنَتۡ مُرۡتَفَقًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika lahum Jannaatu 'Adnin tajree min tahtihimul anhaaru yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min zahabinw wa yalbasoona siyaaban khudram min sundusinw wa istabraqim muttaki'eena feehaa 'alal araaa'ik; ni'mas sawaab; wa hasunat murtafaqaa
ayahs.en: Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place.

ayahs.ar: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلًا رَّجُلَيۡنِ جَعَلۡنَا لِاَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيۡنِ مِنۡ اَعۡنَابٍ وَّحَفَفۡنٰهُمَا بِنَخۡلٍ وَّجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمَا زَرۡعًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wadrib lahum masalar rajulaini ja'alnaa li ahadihimaa jannataini min a'naabinw wa hafafnaahumaa binakhilinw wa ja'alnaa bainahumaa zar'aa
ayahs.en: And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops.

ayahs.ar: كِلۡتَا الۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ اٰتَتۡ اُكُلَهَا وَلَمۡ تَظۡلِمۡ مِّنۡهُ شَيۡـًٔاۙ وَّفَجَّرۡنَا خِلٰلَهُمَا نَهَرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Kiltal jannataini aatat ukulahaa wa lam tazlim minhu shai'anw wa fajjarnaa khi laalahumaa naharaa
ayahs.en: Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river.

ayahs.ar: وَّكَانَ لَهٗ ثَمَرٌۚ فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهٖ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهٗ٘ اَنَا اَكۡثَرُ مِنۡكَ مَالًا وَّاَعَزُّ نَفَرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa kaana lahoo samarun faqaala lisaahibihee wa huwa yuhaawiruhoo ana aksaru minka maalanw wa a'azzu nafaraa
ayahs.en: And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, "I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men."

ayahs.ar: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهٗ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفۡسِهٖۚ قَالَ مَا٘ اَظُنُّ اَنۡ تَبِيۡدَ هٰذِهٖ٘ اَبَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa dakhala jannatahoo wa huwa zaalimul linafsihee qaala maaa azunnu an tabeeda haaziheee abadaa
ayahs.en: And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself. He said, "I do not think that this will perish - ever.

ayahs.ar: وَّمَا٘ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۙ وَّلَئِنۡ رُّدِدۡتُّ اِلٰي رَبِّيۡ لَاَجِدَنَّ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهَا مُنۡقَلَبًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa azunnus Saa'ata qaaa'imatanw wa la'ir rudittu ilaa Rabbee la ajidanna khairam minhaa munqalabaa
ayahs.en: And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهٗ صَاحِبُهٗ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهٗ٘ اَكَفَرۡتَ بِالَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكَ مِنۡ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوّٰىكَ رَجُلًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala lahoo saahibuhoo wa huwa yuhaawiruhooo akafarta billazee khalaqaka min turaabin summa min nutfatin summa sawwaaka rajulaa
ayahs.en: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man?

ayahs.ar: لٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ اللّٰهُ رَبِّيۡ وَلَا٘ اُشۡرِكُ بِرَبِّيۡ٘ اَحَدًا
ayahs.tl: Laakinaa Huwal laahu Rabbee wa laa ushriku bi Rabbeee ahadaa
ayahs.en: But as for me, He is Allah, my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡلَا٘ اِذۡ دَخَلۡتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلۡتَ مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُۙ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِۚ اِنۡ تَرَنِ اَنَا اَقَلَّ مِنۡكَ مَالًا وَّوَلَدًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law laaa iz dakhalta jannataka qulta maa shaaa'al laahu laa quwwata illaa billaah; in tarani ana aqalla minka maalanw wa waladaa
ayahs.en: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allah willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allah '? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children,

ayahs.ar: فَعَسٰي رَبِّيۡ٘ اَنۡ يُّؤۡتِيَنِ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡ جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهَا حُسۡبَانًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَتُصۡبِحَ صَعِيۡدًا زَلَقًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa'asaa Rabeee any yu'tiyani khairam min jannatika wa yursila 'alaihaa husbaanam minas samaaa'i fatusbiha sa'eedan zalaqaa
ayahs.en: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a calamity from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground,

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ يُصۡبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوۡرًا فَلَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ لَهٗ طَلَبًا
ayahs.tl: Aw yusbiha maaa'uhaaa ghawran falan tastatee'a lahoo talabaa
ayahs.en: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it."

ayahs.ar: وَاُحِيۡطَ بِثَمَرِهٖ فَاَصۡبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيۡهِ عَلٰي مَا٘ اَنۡفَقَ فِيۡهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلٰي عُرُوۡشِهَا وَيَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ لَمۡ اُشۡرِكۡ بِرَبِّيۡ٘ اَحَدًا
ayahs.tl: Wa uheeta bisamarihee faasbaha yuqallibu kaffaihi 'alaa maaa anfaqa feehaa wa hiya khaawiyatun 'alaa 'urooshihaa wa yaqoolu yaalaitanee lam ushrik bi Rabbeee ahadaa
ayahs.en: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ لَّهٗ فِئَةٌ يَّنۡصُرُوۡنَهٗ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنۡتَصِرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lam takul lahoo fi'atuny yansuroonahoo min doonil laahi wa maa kaana muntasiraa
ayahs.en: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah, nor could he defend himself.

ayahs.ar: هُنَالِكَ الۡوَلَايَةُ لِلّٰهِ الۡحَقِّؕ هُوَ خَيۡرٌ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيۡرٌ عُقۡبًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Hunaalikal walaayatu lillaahil haqq; huwa khairun sawaabanw wa khairun 'uqbaa
ayahs.en: There the authority is [completely] for Allah, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.

ayahs.ar: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا كَمَآءٍ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ فَاخۡتَلَطَ بِهٖ نَبَاتُ الۡاَرۡضِ فَاَصۡبَحَ هَشِيۡمًا تَذۡرُوۡهُ الرِّيٰحُؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ مُّقۡتَدِرًا
ayahs.tl: Wadrib lahum masalal hayaatid dunyaa kamaaa'in anzalnaahu minas samaaa'i fakhtalata bihee nabaatul ardi fa asbaha hasheeman tazroo hur riyaah; wa kaanal laahu 'alaa kulli shai'im muqtadiraa
ayahs.en: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.

ayahs.ar: اَلۡمَالُ وَالۡبَنُوۡنَ زِيۡنَةُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَالۡبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيۡرٌ اَمَلًا
ayahs.tl: Almaalu walbanoona zeenatul hayaatid dunya wal baaqiyaatus saalihaatu khairun 'inda Rabbika sawaabanw wa khairun amalaa
ayahs.en: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نُسَيِّرُ الۡجِبَالَ وَتَرَي الۡاَرۡضَ بَارِزَةًۙ وَّحَشَرۡنٰهُمۡ فَلَمۡ نُغَادِرۡ مِنۡهُمۡ اَحَدًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yawma nusaiyirul jibaala wa taral arda baariza tanw wa hasharnaahum falam nughaadir minhum ahadaa
ayahs.en: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth prominent, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone.

ayahs.ar: وَعُرِضُوۡا عَلٰي رَبِّكَ صَفًّاؕ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتُمُوۡنَا كَمَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۭؗ بَلۡ زَعَمۡتُمۡ اَلَّنۡ نَّجۡعَلَ لَكُمۡ مَّوۡعِدًا
ayahs.tl: Wa 'uridoo 'alaa Rabbika saffaa, laqad ji'tumoonaa kamaa khalaqnaakum awala marrah; bal za'amtum allannaj'ala lakum maw'idaa
ayahs.en: And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], "You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment."

ayahs.ar: وَوُضِعَ الۡكِتٰبُ فَتَرَي الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ مُشۡفِقِيۡنَ مِمَّا فِيۡهِ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ يٰوَيۡلَتَنَا مَالِ هٰذَا الۡكِتٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيۡرَةً وَّلَا كَبِيۡرَةً اِلَّا٘ اَحۡصٰىهَاۚ وَوَجَدُوۡا مَا عَمِلُوۡا حَاضِرًاؕ وَلَا يَظۡلِمُ رَبُّكَ اَحَدًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa wudi'al kitaabu fataral mujrimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa feehi wa yaqooloona yaa wailatanaa maa lihaazal kitaabi laa yughaadiru saghee ratanw wa laa kabeeratan illaaa ahsaahaa; wa wajadoo maa 'amiloo haadiraa; wa laa yazlimu Rabbuka ahadaa
ayahs.en: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ كَانَ مِنَ الۡجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنۡ اَمۡرِ رَبِّهٖؕ اَفَتَتَّخِذُوۡنَهٗ وَذُرِّيَّتَهٗ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِيۡ وَهُمۡ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّؕ بِئۡسَ لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ بَدَلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qulnaa lilma laaa'ikatis judoo li Aadama fasajadooo illaaa Ibleesa kaana minal jinni fafasaqa 'an amri Rabbih; afatattakhizoonahoo wa zurriyatahooo awliyaaa'a min doonee wa hum lakum 'aduww; bi'sa lizzaalimeena badalaa
ayahs.en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange.

ayahs.ar: مَا٘ اَشۡهَدۡتُّهُمۡ خَلۡقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا خَلۡقَ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡࣕ وَمَا كُنۡتُ مُتَّخِذَ الۡمُضِلِّيۡنَ عَضُدًا
ayahs.tl: Maaa ash hattuhum khalqas samaawaati wal ardi wa laa khalqa anfusihim wa maa kuntu muttakizal mudilleena 'adudaa
ayahs.en: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يَقُوۡلُ نَادُوۡا شُرَكَآءِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ مَّوۡبِقًا
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma yaqoolu naadoo shurakaaa'i yal lazeena za'amtum fada'awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum wa ja'alnaa bainahum maw biqaa
ayahs.en: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, "Call 'My partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction.

ayahs.ar: وَرَاَ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ مُّوَاقِعُوۡهَا وَلَمۡ يَجِدُوۡا عَنۡهَا مَصۡرِفًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ra al mujrimoonan Naara fazannooo annahum muwaaqi'oohaa wa lam yajidoo 'anhaa masrifaa
ayahs.en: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا فِيۡ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ لِلنَّاسِ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَثَلٍؕ وَكَانَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَكۡثَرَ شَيۡءٍ جَدَلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad sarrafnaa fee haazal quraani linnaasi mn kulli masal; wa kaanal insaanu aksara shai'in jadalaa
ayahs.en: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur'an for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ اَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡ٘ا اِذۡ جَآءَهُمُ الۡهُدٰي وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ سُنَّةُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ اَوۡ يَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ قُبُلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa maa mana'an naasa any yu'minooo iz jaaa'ahumul hudaa wa yastaghfiroo Rabbahum illaaa an taatiyahum sunnatul awwaleena aw yaatiyahumul 'azaabu qubulaa
ayahs.en: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرِيۡنَ وَمُنۡذِرِيۡنَۚ وَيُجَادِلُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِالۡبَاطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُوۡا بِهِ الۡحَقَّ وَاتَّخَذُوۡ٘ا اٰيٰتِيۡ وَمَا٘ اُنۡذِرُوۡا هُزُوًا
ayahs.tl: Wa maa nursilul mursaleena illaa mubashshireena wa munzireen; wa yujaadilul lazeena kafaroo bilbaatili liyudhidoo bihil haqqa wattakhazooo Aayaatee wa maaa unziroo huzuwaa
ayahs.en: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنۡ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ فَاَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدٰهُؕ اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ اَكِنَّةً اَنۡ يَّفۡقَهُوۡهُ وَفِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرًاؕ وَاِنۡ تَدۡعُهُمۡ اِلَي الۡهُدٰي فَلَنۡ يَّهۡتَدُوۡ٘ا اِذًا اَبَدًا
ayahs.tl: Wa man azlamu mimman zukkira bi ayaati Rabbihee fa-a'rada 'anhaa wa nasiya maa qaddamat yadaah; innaa ja'alnaa 'alaa quloobihim akinnatan any yafqahoohu wa feee aazaanihim waqraa; wa in tad'uhum ilal hudaa falany yahtadooo izan abadaa
ayahs.en: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.

ayahs.ar: وَرَبُّكَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ ذُو الرَّحۡمَةِؕ لَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُهُمۡ بِمَا كَسَبُوۡا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الۡعَذَابَؕ بَلۡ لَّهُمۡ مَّوۡعِدٌ لَّنۡ يَّجِدُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مَوۡئِلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa Rabbukal Ghafooru zur rahmati law yu'aakhi zuhum bimaa kasaboo la'ajala lahumul 'azaab; bal lahum maw'idul lany yajidoo min doonihee maw'ilaa
ayahs.en: And your Lord is the Forgiving, full of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.

ayahs.ar: وَتِلۡكَ الۡقُرٰ٘ي اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوۡا وَجَعَلۡنَا لِمَهۡلِكِهِمۡ مَّوۡعِدًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa tkal quraaa ahlak nahum lammaa zulamoo wa ja'alnaa limahlikihim maw'idaa
ayahs.en: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰي لِفَتٰىهُ لَا٘ اَبۡرَحُ حَتّٰ٘ي اَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ اَوۡ اَمۡضِيَ حُقُبًا
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaalaa Moosaa lifataahu laaa abrahu hattaaa ablugha majma'al bahrayni aw amdiya huqubaa
ayahs.en: And [mention] when Moses said to his servant, "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجۡمَعَ بَيۡنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوۡتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيۡلَهٗ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ سَرَبًا
ayahs.tl: Falammaa balaghaa majma'a bainihimaa nasiyaa hootahumaa fattakhaza sabeelahoo fil bahri sarabaa
ayahs.en: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتٰىهُ اٰتِنَا غَدَآءَنَاؗ لَقَدۡ لَقِيۡنَا مِنۡ سَفَرِنَا هٰذَا نَصَبًا
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaawazaa qaala lifataahu aatinaa ghadaaa'anaa laqad laqeena min safarinaa haazaa nasabaa
ayahs.en: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَرَءَيۡتَ اِذۡ اَوَيۡنَا٘ اِلَي الصَّخۡرَةِ فَاِنِّيۡ نَسِيۡتُ الۡحُوۡتَؗ وَمَا٘ اَنۡسٰىنِيۡهُ اِلَّا الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَنۡ اَذۡكُرَهٗۚ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيۡلَهٗ فِي الۡبَحۡرِࣗۖ عَجَبًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala ara'ayta iz awainaaa ilas sakhrati fa innee naseetul hoota wa maaa ansaaneehu illash Shaitaanu an azkurah; wattakhaza sabeelahoo fil bahri'ajabaa
ayahs.en: He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly".

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبۡغِࣗۖ فَارۡتَدَّا عَلٰ٘ي اٰثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala zaalika maa kunnaa nabgh; fartaddaa 'alaa aasaari him maa qasasaa
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.

ayahs.ar: فَوَجَدَا عَبۡدًا مِّنۡ عِبَادِنَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا وَعَلَّمۡنٰهُ مِنۡ لَّدُنَّا عِلۡمًا
ayahs.tl: Fa wajadaa 'abdam min 'ibaadinaaa aatainaahu Rahmatam min 'indinaa wa 'allamnaahu mil ladunnaa 'ilmaa
ayahs.en: And they found a servant from among Our servants to whom we had given mercy from us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهٗ مُوۡسٰي هَلۡ اَتَّبِعُكَ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمۡتَ رُشۡدًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala lahoo Moosaa hal attabi'uka 'alaaa an tu'allimani mimmaa 'ullimta rushdaa
ayahs.en: Moses said to him, "May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaalaa innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa
ayahs.en: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.

ayahs.ar: وَكَيۡفَ تَصۡبِرُ عَلٰي مَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهٖ خُبۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa kaifa tasbiru 'alaa maa lam tuhit bihee khubraa
ayahs.en: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِيۡ٘ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ صَابِرًا وَّلَا٘ اَعۡصِيۡ لَكَ اَمۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala satajiduneee in shaa 'al laahu saabiranw wa laaa a'see laka amraa
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاِنِ اتَّبَعۡتَنِيۡ فَلَا تَسۡـَٔلۡنِيۡ عَنۡ شَيۡءٍ حَتّٰ٘ي اُحۡدِثَ لَكَ مِنۡهُ ذِكۡرًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala fa init taba'tanee falaa tas'alnee 'an shai'in hattaaa uhdisa laka minhu zikraa
ayahs.en: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention."

ayahs.ar: فَانۡطَلَقَاࣞ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا رَكِبَا فِي السَّفِيۡنَةِ خَرَقَهَاؕ قَالَ اَخَرَقۡتَهَا لِتُغۡرِقَ اَهۡلَهَاۚ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـًٔا اِمۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Fantalaqaa hattaaa izaa rakibaa fis safeenati kharaqahaa qaala akharaqtahaa litughriqa ahlahaa laqad ji'ta shai'an imraa
ayahs.en: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, al-Khidh r tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala alam aqul innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa
ayahs.en: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنِيۡ بِمَا نَسِيۡتُ وَلَا تُرۡهِقۡنِيۡ مِنۡ اَمۡرِيۡ عُسۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala laa tu'aakhiznee bimaa naseetu wa laa turhiqnee min amree 'usraa
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not cover me in my matter with difficulty."

ayahs.ar: فَانۡطَلَقَاࣞ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا لَقِيَا غُلٰمًا فَقَتَلَهٗۙ قَالَ اَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسًا زَكِيَّةًۭ بِغَيۡرِ نَفۡسٍؕ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـًٔا نُّكۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Fantalaqaa hattaa izaa laqiyaa ghulaaman faqatalahoo qaala aqatalta nafsan zakiy yatam bighairi nafs; laqad ji'ta shai'an nukraa
ayahs.en: So they set out, until when they met a boy, al-Khidh r killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ لَّكَ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa
ayahs.en: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنۡ سَاَلۡتُكَ عَنۡ شَيۡءٍۭ بَعۡدَهَا فَلَا تُصٰحِبۡنِيۡۚ قَدۡ بَلَغۡتَ مِنۡ لَّدُنِّيۡ عُذۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala in sa altuka 'an shai'im ba'dahaa falaa tusaahibnee qad balaghta mil ladunnee 'uzraa
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."

ayahs.ar: فَانۡطَلَقَاࣞ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَتَيَا٘ اَهۡلَ قَرۡيَةِ اِۨسۡتَطۡعَمَا٘ اَهۡلَهَا فَاَبَوۡا اَنۡ يُّضَيِّفُوۡهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيۡهَا جِدَارًا يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يَّنۡقَضَّ فَاَقَامَهٗؕ قَالَ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ لَتَّخَذۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ اَجۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Fantalaqaa hattaaa izaaa atayaaa ahla qaryatinis tat'amaaa ahlahaa fa abaw any yudaiyifoohumaa fawajadaa feehaa jidaarany yureedu any yanqadda fa aqaamah; qaala law shi'ta lattakhazta 'alaihi ajraa
ayahs.en: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنِكَۚ سَاُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَاۡوِيۡلِ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡتَطِعۡ عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala haazaa firaaqu bainee wa bainik; sa unabi 'uka bitaaweeli maa lam tastati' 'alaihi sabraa
ayahs.en: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.

ayahs.ar: اَمَّا السَّفِيۡنَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسٰكِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ فَاَرَدۡتُّ اَنۡ اَعِيۡبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ مَّلِكٌ يَّاۡخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِيۡنَةٍ غَصۡبًا
ayahs.tl: Ammas safeenatu fakaanat limasaakeena ya'maloona fil bahri fa arattu an a'eebahaa wa kaana waraaa' ahum malikuny yaakhuzu kulla safeenatin ghasbaa
ayahs.en: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا الۡغُلٰمُ فَكَانَ اَبَوٰهُ مُؤۡمِنَيۡنِ فَخَشِيۡنَا٘ اَنۡ يُّرۡهِقَهُمَا طُغۡيَانًا وَّكُفۡرًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa aammal ghulaamu fakaana abawaahu mu'minaini fakhasheenaaa any yurhiqa humaa tughyaananw wa kufraa
ayahs.en: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.

ayahs.ar: فَاَرَدۡنَا٘ اَنۡ يُّبۡدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهُ زَكٰوةً وَّاَقۡرَبَ رُحۡمًا
ayahs.tl: Faradnaa any yubdila humaa Rabbuhumaa khairam minhu zakaatanw wa aqraba ruhmaa
ayahs.en: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا الۡجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلٰمَيۡنِ يَتِيۡمَيۡنِ فِي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ وَكَانَ تَحۡتَهٗ كَنۡزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ اَبُوۡهُمَا صَالِحًاۚ فَاَرَادَ رَبُّكَ اَنۡ يَّبۡلُغَا٘ اَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسۡتَخۡرِجَا كَنۡزَهُمَاࣗۖ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَۚ وَمَا فَعَلۡتُهٗ عَنۡ اَمۡرِيۡؕ ذٰلِكَ تَاۡوِيۡلُ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡطِعۡ عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًاؕࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ammal jidaaru fakaana lighulaamaini yateemaini fil madeenati wa kaana tahtahoo kanzul lahumaa wa kaana aboohumaa saalihan fa araada Rabbuka any yablughaaa ashuddahumaa wa yastakhrijaa kanzahumaa rahmatam mir Rabbik; wa maa fa'altuhoo 'an amree; zaalika taaweelu maa lam tasti' 'alaihi sabra
ayahs.en: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."

ayahs.ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنۡ ذِي الۡقَرۡنَيۡنِؕ قُلۡ سَاَتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ ذِكۡرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yas'aloonaka 'an Zil Qarnaini qul sa atloo 'alaikum minhu zikraa
ayahs.en: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهٗ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ سَبَبًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa makkannaa lahoo fil ardi wa aatainaahu min kulli shai'in sababaa
ayahs.en: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.

ayahs.ar: فَاَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا
ayahs.tl: Fa atba'a sababaa
ayahs.en: So he followed a way

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ الشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغۡرُبُ فِيۡ عَيۡنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَّوَجَدَ عِنۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا ࣢ؕ قُلۡنَا يٰذَا الۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ اِمَّا٘ اَنۡ تُعَذِّبَ وَاِمَّا٘ اَنۡ تَتَّخِذَ فِيۡهِمۡ حُسۡنًا
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa balagha maghribash shamsi wajadahaaa taghrubu fee 'aynin hami'a tinw wa wajada 'indahaa qawmaa; qulnaa yaa Zal Qarnaini immaaa an tu'az ziba wa immaaa an tattakhiza feehim husnaa
ayahs.en: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. Allah said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَمَّا مَنۡ ظَلَمَ فَسَوۡفَ نُعَذِّبُهٗ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ فَيُعَذِّبُهٗ عَذَابًا نُّكۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaala amaa man zalama fasawfa nu'azzibuhoo summa yuraddu ilaa Rabbihee fa yu 'azzibuhoo azaaban nukraa
ayahs.en: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهٗ جَزَآءَ اِۨلۡحُسۡنٰيۚ وَسَنَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ مِنۡ اَمۡرِنَا يُسۡرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ammaa man aamana wa 'amila saalihan falahoo jazaaa'anil husnaa wa sanaqoolu lahoo min amrinaa yusraa
ayahs.en: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease."

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا
ayahs.tl: Summa atba'a sababaa
ayahs.en: Then he followed a way

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا بَلَغَ مَطۡلِعَ الشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطۡلُعُ عَلٰي قَوۡمٍ لَّمۡ نَجۡعَلۡ لَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهَا سِتۡرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa balagha matli'ash shamsi wajdahaa tatlu'u alaa qawmil lam naj'al lahum min doonihaa sitraa
ayahs.en: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَؕ وَقَدۡ اَحَطۡنَا بِمَا لَدَيۡهِ خُبۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Kazaalika wa qad ahatnaa bimaa ladaihi khubraa
ayahs.en: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا
ayahs.tl: Summa atba'a sababaa
ayahs.en: Then he followed a way

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا بَلَغَ بَيۡنَ السَّدَّيۡنِ وَجَدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمَا قَوۡمًاۙ لَّا يَكَادُوۡنَ يَفۡقَهُوۡنَ قَوۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa balagha bainas saddaini wajada min doonihimaa qawmal laa yakaa doona yafqahoona qawlaa
ayahs.en: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰذَا الۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ اِنَّ يَاۡجُوۡجَ وَمَاۡجُوۡجَ مُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَهَلۡ نَجۡعَلُ لَكَ خَرۡجًا عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ تَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ سَدًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa Zal qarnaini inna Yaajooja wa Maajooja mufsidoona fil ardi fahal naj'alu laka kharjan 'alaaa an taj'ala bainanaa wa bainahum saddas
ayahs.en: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّيۡ فِيۡهِ رَبِّيۡ خَيۡرٌ فَاَعِيۡنُوۡنِيۡ بِقُوَّةٍ اَجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ رَدۡمًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala maa makkannee feehi Rabbee khairun fa-a'eenoonee biquwwatin aj'al bainakum wa bainahum radmaa
ayahs.en: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam.

ayahs.ar: اٰتُوۡنِيۡ زُبَرَ الۡحَدِيۡدِؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا سَاوٰي بَيۡنَ الصَّدَفَيۡنِ قَالَ انۡفُخُوۡاؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَعَلَهٗ نَارًاۙ قَالَ اٰتُوۡنِيۡ٘ اُفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡهِ قِطۡرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Aatoonee zubaral hadeed, hattaaa izaa saawaa bainas sadafaini qaalan fukhoo hattaaa izaa ja'alahoo naaran qaala aatooneee ufrigh 'alaihi qitraa
ayahs.en: Bring me sheets of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."

ayahs.ar: فَمَا اسۡطَاعُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّظۡهَرُوۡهُ وَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا لَهٗ نَقۡبًا
ayahs.tl: Famas taa'ooo any yazharoohu wa mastataa'oo lahoo naqbaa
ayahs.en: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هٰذَا رَحۡمَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّيۡۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّيۡ جَعَلَهٗ دَكَّآءَۚ وَكَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّيۡ حَقًّاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala haaza rahmatummir Rabbee fa izaa jaaa'a wa'du Rabbee ja'alahoo dakkaaa'a; wa kaana; wa du Rabbee haqqaa
ayahs.en: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّمُوۡجُ فِيۡ بَعۡضٍ وَّنُفِخَ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَجَمَعۡنٰهُمۡ جَمۡعًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa taraknaa ba'dahum Yawma'iziny yamooju fee ba'dinw wa nufikha fis Soori fajama'naahum jam'aa
ayahs.en: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.

ayahs.ar: وَّعَرَضۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ عَرۡضَاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa 'aradnaa jahannama Yawma'izil lilkaafireena 'ardaa
ayahs.en: And We will present Hell that Day to the Disbelievers, on display -

ayahs.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡنَ كَانَتۡ اَعۡيُنُهُمۡ فِيۡ غِطَآءٍ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِيۡ وَكَانُوۡا لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ سَمۡعًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena kaanat a'yunuhum fee ghitaaa'in 'an zikree wa kaanoo la yastatee'oona sam'aa
ayahs.en: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.

ayahs.ar: اَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذُوۡا عِبَادِيۡ مِنۡ دُوۡنِيۡ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَؕ اِنَّا٘ اَعۡتَدۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ نُزُلًا
ayahs.tl: Afahasibal lazeena kafarooo any yattakhizoo 'ibaadee min dooneee awliyaaa'; innaaa a'tadnaa jahannama lilkaafi reena nuzulaa
ayahs.en: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ هَلۡ نُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِالۡاَخۡسَرِيۡنَ اَعۡمَالًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul hal nunabbi'ukum bilakhsareena a'maalaa
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ ضَلَّ سَعۡيُهُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ يُحۡسِنُوۡنَ صُنۡعًا
ayahs.tl: Allazeena dalla sa'yuhum fil hayaatid dunyaa wa hum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sun'aa
ayahs.en: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلِقَآئِهٖ فَحَبِطَتۡ اَعۡمَالُهُمۡ فَلَا نُقِيۡمُ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَزۡنًا
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena kafaroo bi aayaati Rabbihim wa liqaaa'ihee fahabitat a'maaluhum falaa nuqeemu lahum Yawmal Qiyaamati waznaa
ayahs.en: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوۡا وَاتَّخَذُوۡ٘ا اٰيٰتِيۡ وَرُسُلِيۡ هُزُوًا
ayahs.tl: Zaalika jazaaa'uhum jahannamu bimaa kafaroo wattakhazooo Aayaatee wa Rusulee huzuwaa
ayahs.en: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ الۡفِرۡدَوۡسِ نُزُلًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati kaanat lahum Jannaatul Firdawsi nuzulaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,

ayahs.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا لَا يَبۡغُوۡنَ عَنۡهَا حِوَلًا
ayahs.tl: Khaalideena feeha la yabghoona 'anhaa hiwalaa
ayahs.en: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لَّوۡ كَانَ الۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمٰتِ رَبِّيۡ لَنَفِدَ الۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ تَنۡفَدَ كَلِمٰتُ رَبِّيۡ وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهٖ مَدَدًا
ayahs.tl: Qul law kaanal bahru midaadal lik Kalimaati Rabbee lanafidal bahru qabla an tanfada Kalimaatu Rabbee wa law ji'naa bimislihee madadaa
ayahs.en: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَمَنۡ كَانَ يَرۡجُوۡا لِقَآءَ رَبِّهٖ فَلۡيَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَّلَا يُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهٖ٘ اَحَدًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul innamaaa ana basharum mislukum yoohaaa ilaiya annamaa ilaahukum Ilaahunw Waahid; faman kaana yarjoo liqaaa'a Rabbihee falya'mal 'amalan saalihanw wa laa yushrik bi'ibaadati Rabbiheee ahadaa
ayahs.en: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
